## About
Peruva started as a small garage in San Rafael that could only fit one vehicle at a time, run by Luis Arcos, the President. Luis fell for cars as a kid, watching the mechanic at a shop near his house, and later went to automobile mechanic school in Lima, where he learned engines and transmissions.
After coming to the United States, he worked at the Rino Gas Station in Fairfax, made friends and kept learning. Over the years he earned the trust and friendship of many customers, and Peruva now has shops in San Rafael, Fairfax and Sausalito.
Our San Rafael shop holds a 4.4 rating from 52 Google reviews. If you don't see the service you need on our list, give us a call.

## Services
- Engine and transmission: Engine repair, maintenance and performance checks, plus transmission diagnostics, maintenance and replacement.
- Tires balance and rotation: Balancing and rotating your tires so they wear evenly.
- Heating and cooling: Heating and cooling system diagnostics, heating system repair, and compressor and evaporator work.
- Exhaust repair: Exhaust, muffler and tailpipe repair and replacement, along with exhaust and pipe welding.
- Electrical repairs: Electrical diagnostics, alternators, starters, power windows and locks, wipers and lights.

## FAQ
Q: When is the San Rafael shop open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on weekends.

Q: How long does it take to confirm an appointment?
A: After you request an appointment online, please allow us up to 24 hours to confirm. We'll send you an email confirming it.

Q: What if I don't see the service I need?
A: Give us a call and ask.
